name: Recovered Paired Root Factor with a Noncorner Core Root
definition: Take the 292-concept family $H$ rooted at its noncorner vertex 29, translate that root to zero to obtain $C$, and use the two one-concept extensions by 128 and 290 as the side repairs in the paired-square construction.
parameters: The output has 879 concepts, dimension 14, VC dimension five, and eleven corners.
properties: The construction is a rooted factor even though the recovered core root is not a corner. Its sections and two repair concepts are intrinsically recovered from the marked degree-two root. The certificate checks all 24 rooted elementary orders of $C$, all 28 of the output, and a complete 704-state negative graph.
